Answer: B
Reason: The serial chest X-rays (Figures 1a, 3a, 4a, 6a) demonstrate a clear progression from initial nodular densities in the middle and lower lung fields to extensive, diffuse bilateral infiltrative involvement with increasing radiolucencies over time, consistent with the aggressive spread of bronchioloalveolar carcinoma. Options suggesting stability, regression, or isolated upper lobe onset are contradicted by the visual evidence of worsening diffuse disease.
